name: any-function-type-test-d439f10943/any-function-type-v.bal

spec_references.heading: Subset restrictions > Import declarations
spec_references.quote: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported
spec_references.detail: The ballerina/lang.value list includes cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString; it excludes cloneReadOnly. The ballerina/lang.error list includes message only; it excludes detail.

spec_references.heading: Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions
spec_references.quote: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:
spec_references.detail: The exhaustive list includes value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString, value:toBalString and error:message, but not value:cloneReadOnly or error:detail.

reason: The complete case requires arr.cloneReadOnly() in testRuntimeHashCodeViaFunctionEquality, a lang.value operation excluded by both supported lang-library methods and supported method-call lists. It also calls e.detail(), which is excluded for lang.error. These essential operations make the whole case a feature request regardless of support for its function types, casts and type tests.
test_design_notes: Mixed case covers general and isolated function values, narrowing/casts, records/maps, class fields, anonymous functions, readonly cloning and never return types.
io:println and @output comments are ordinary output instrumentation and are not classification grounds.
No @error markers; some runtime casts deliberately trap errors.
